title: Record the address-operator composition
body:
## Summary
- For the canonical root `(2, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)`, exchanging every address half and then the normal line equals exchanging the complement, on all 16 basis pairs.
- The full exchange sends that root from the head bank to the tail bank, and the complement leaves it on the head bank.
- No new kappa. The 111 port boundary charts are not rerun.
